  Special Meeting Agenda
  CITY COUNCIL

Tuesday, December 7, 2021  5:00 PM  Teleconference

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Mayor has called a Special Meeting of the City Council, to be called to
order via teleconference at 5:00 p.m. on Tuesday, December 7, 2021. The agenda for the Special Meeting with
the items of business to be transacted or discussed is set forth below.
Posted by the office of the City Clerk on Thursday, December 2, 2021.

NOTE:  PUBLIC PARTICIPATION INFORMATION
  In accordance with Assembly Bill 361 (AB 361) and City Council Resolution No. 2490, due to the
  continuing state of emergency, including masking and social distancing directives as a result of the threat
  of the COVID-19 virus, this meeting is being held remotely via teleconference. There will not be a physical
  location for this meeting. Members of the public may participate in the meeting in the following ways:

  - Members of the public may listen to the meeting live by calling: (1 669 900 6833) from any phone,
  Meeting ID:
  873 6000 1057 Meeting Password: 949440. (Please note you will not have the ability to speak using the
  call in option from a phone line.)

  - Public correspondence may be emailed to the City Clerk at laurenp@rollinghillsestatesca.gov. Emails
  received before 3:00 p.m. prior to the start of the meeting will be forwarded to the City Council for their
  consideration and included as part of the record.

  - Members of the public may also comment online using eComment on the “Meeting Agendas, Minutes &
  Videos” page of the City’s website (www.rhe.city/MeetingAgendas). Once the agenda is published, there
  will be an “eComment” button next to the linked agenda under "Upcoming Events". Follow this link to
  the City’s SpeakUp page. After you register, you may comment on any item on that particular agenda.
  These comments can be seen by the public, will be considered by the Council and become part of the
  record.

  - Members of the public who wish to speak during this meeting may join the Zoom meeting by accessing the
  Zoom app from a computer (downloaded at Zoom.com) or tablet or phone (downloaded in the App Store),
  by entering the following credentials: Meeting ID: 873 6000 1057, Meeting Password: 949440. Members
  of the public who join the Zoom meeting will not have video, and may request to speak using the following
  process: After joining the Zoom meeting, if you wish to speak, please select the "raise hand" option at the
  lower portion of your screen. The City Clerk will send you a chat message to identify which item on the
  agenda you would like to speak on and will unmute your mic at the appropriate time.

  Agenda reports and other disclosable public records relating to each Open Session agenda item are
  available on the City's website under Meeting Agendas, Minutes & Videos at www.rhe.city.

minutes_text:
MINUTES
  SPECIAL CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  DECEMBER 7, 2021

1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

A Special Joint meeting of the City Council and Planning Commission of the City of Rolling
Hills Estates was called to order by MAYOR ZUCKERMAN at 5:10 pm remotely via
teleconference, in accordance with Assembly Bill 361 (AB 361) and City Council Resolution
No. 2490, due to the continuing state of emergency, including masking and social distancing
directives as a result of the threat of the COVID-19 virus.

3.  ROLL CALL

City Council Members Present:  Huff, Schmitz, Stegura, Zerunyan and Zuckerman

City Council Members Absent:  None.

City Staff Present:  City Clerk Lauren Pettit

4.  NEW BUSINESS

A.  INTERVIEWS OF COMMISSIONERS WITH EXPIRING TERMS, AND APPLICANTS
  FOR PLANNING COMMISSION AND ENVIRONMENTAL ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  VACANCIES

The City Council conducted the following interviews, via Zoom Video Teleconference, of
Planning Commissioners and Park & Activities Commissioners whose terms expire
December 31, 2021:

  5:10 – Judy Bain
  5:20 – Lou Persichina
  5:30 – Kirk Retz
  5:40 – Robert Medawar
  5:50 – Robert Schachter
  6:10 – Victor Yoo
  6:20 – Tim Zigrang

During his interview, Commissioner Zigrang stated that he is no longer wishes to be
reappointed to the Planning Commission due to the fact that he will be moving out of state
mid-next year. This created a total of two vacancies on the Planning Commission for 2022.

The City Council conducted interviews for following applicants, via Zoom Video
Teleconference, for the two vacancies on the Planning Commission:

  6:40 – Michele Low
  6:50 – Jeff Chuang
  7:10 – Sabine Butcher
  7:20 – Larry Olson

The City Council conducted interviews for following applicants, via Zoom Video
Teleconference, for the two vacancies on the Environmental Advisory Committee:

  7:30 – Jim Tarr
  7:40 – Joan Friedman

The City Council then deliberated on the interviews conducted and came to the following
consensus:

  -  REAPPOINT THE FOLLOWING PLANNING COMMISSIONERS FOR
  TWO-YEAR TERMS EXPIRING ON DECEMBER 31, 2023: ROBERT
  MEDAWAR, ROBERT SCHACHTER AND VICTOR YOO;

SPECIAL JOINT CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  1
DECEMBER 7, 2021
   -  REAPPOINT THE FOLLOWING PARK & ACTIVITIES COMMISSIONERS
  FOR TWO-YEAR TERMS EXPIRING ON DECEMBER 31, 2023: JUDY
  BAIN, LOU PERSICHINA, AND KIRK RETZ;
  -  REAPPOINT ALL INTERESTED COMMITTEE MEMBERS FOR ONE
  YEAR TERMS EXPIRING DECEMBER 31, 2021;
  -  APPOINT THE FOLLOWING APPLICANTS TO THE PLANNING
  COMMISSION FOR ONE YEAR TERMS EXPIRING DECEMBER 31,
  2022: MICHELE LOW AND LARRY OLSON;
  -  APPOINT THE FOLLOWING APPLICANTS TO THE ENVIRONMENTAL
  ADVISORY COMMITTEE FOR ONE YEAR TERMS EXPIRING
  DECEMBER 31, 2022: JEFF CHUANG, JIM TARR AND JOAN
  FRIEDMAN.

6.  ADJOURNMENT

At 8:50 pm MAYOR ZUCKERMAN adjourned the Special Joint City Council meeting to the
next regular City Council meeting on Tuesday, December 14, 2021, at 7:00 pm for the
purpose of a Regular meeting.

Submitted by,  Approved by,

Lauren Pettit  Steve Zuckerman
City Clerk  Mayor

SPECIAL JOINT CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  2
DECEMBER 7, 2021
